review: Exact normalized delta is three version-pinned dynamic import URLs and their matching three ambient module declarations. Existing timeline, media selection, metadata fallback, rendering and scientific context code is unchanged.
html-to-image 1.11.11, exifr 7.1.3 and music-metadata-browser 2.5.10 now use their jsDelivr ESM entrypoints. No downloaded third-party code, media or datasets are added to the public proposal.

Isolated headless Chrome loaded the real CDN modules and exercised toPng on a synthetic DOM, parse on a generated JPEG carrying a known EXIF date, and parseBlob on a generated one-second WAV. All three passed. Response hashes and the twenty transitive module GET requests were recorded; none carried a request body.
The calls remain explicit local file/DOM operations. Failures retain existing optional metadata/export error paths. There is no account, room, program grant, model or scientific operator change.
limits: Unfrozen and unpublished source proposal. Browser checks exercise dependency APIs, not the complete timeline or installed Electron CSP.
Version pins are not cryptographic integrity enforcement or a future CDN availability guarantee. Captured response hashes describe this check only.
Only synthetic JPEG metadata, WAV duration and DOM PNG export were checked. Other formats, remote-image export, network failure recovery and native installed behavior remain separate.
No third-party code or datasets copied. Existing notices remain in place; future bundled dependencies require their own exact-byte license review.
Five inherited intentional support-contact matches remain in final owner publication review.
